nusmp.engraving_codex.tip.kind: A book of every engraving in the mod
nusmp.engraving_codex.tip.lore: What each engraving does, its cooldowns and caps, and which items carry it.
nusmp.engraving_codex.tip.use: Use: open the book. Type in the search box to find an engraving or an item.
nusmp.engraving_codex.cmd.console: Only a player can be handed the Engravement Codex.
nusmp.engraving_codex.cmd.given: You were given the Engravement Codex. Use it to open the list of every engraving.
nusmp.engraving_codex.cmd.where: You can also craft it (a book, 2 amethyst shards and 2 ink sacs in a cross) or take it from the Multiverse of Anime creative tab.
nusmp.engraving_codex.hint: Wheel, arrows or PageUp / PageDown turn the page.
nusmp.engraving_codex.found_none: no item of this mod carries it yet
enchantment.nusmp.anti_magic.desc: A mark carried by the Black Clover anti-magic blades (the Demon-Slayer family, the Demon-Slasher Katana and the Nakagami Edge). It has no numbers of its own: what those blades do against magic comes from their own abilities, which are on their cards.
